title: Methuen Memorial Music Hall

services.name: Hall Rentals
services.desc: The Methuen Memorial Music Hall, Inc. first opened in 1909 as the Serlo Organ Hall. Built by Edward F. Searles, the Hall is home to the Great Organ, the first concert pipe organ in the United States. It was originally installed in 1863 in the Boston Music Hall. Mr. Searles purchased the pipe organ in 1897, moving it to Methuen and commissioning esteemed architect Henry Vaughn to design a home fit for the beautiful instrument. The building was named Serlo Organ Hall. After Mr. Searles’ passing, the music hall and adjacent factory continued through several private owners.
